The '''Quermian''' language was the native language of the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] species from [[Quermia/Legends|Quermia]]. It was a melodious language to hear. The Quermian alphabet had exactly as many vowels as consonants. Most Quermians were fluent in both Quermian language and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], being literate in both languages.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
